name: Hospital Elevator
tagline: Wide enough for a trolley, gentle enough for the patient on it.
summary: Deep stretcher-capable cars with accurate levelling, wide clear openings and wipe-clean surfaces, built for hospitals, nursing homes and diagnostic centres.

applications.name: Hospitals & clinics
applications.description: Stretcher-width cars, levelling accuracy, and dependable emergency behaviour.

overview:
A hospital lift is dimensioned by the trolley, not the passenger count. The car is deep rather than wide so a bed, its attendants and an IV stand fit without turning, and the clear opening is sized to let all of that through in one movement.

Ride quality matters more here than anywhere else. Acceleration is shaped gently, levelling is held tight so a trolley wheel does not catch on the sill, and the whole car interior is specified in surfaces that can be cleaned down between uses. Zion has delivered this configuration at Owaisi Hospitals in Hyderabad.

safety_features.name: Overload detection
safety_features.headline: The car will not move if it is asked to carry too much.
safety_features.description: Load cells under the car platform measure weight continuously. Past the rated load the doors stay open, an audible warning sounds and the car holds at the landing until weight is removed.
safety_features.test_procedure: The car is loaded past 110% of rated capacity; departure must be inhibited.

safety_features.name: Automatic rescue device
safety_features.headline: A power cut moves you to the nearest floor, not nowhere.
safety_features.description: On mains failure the ARD battery takes over, drives the car at reduced speed to the nearest landing, opens the doors and holds the cabin light and fan on.
safety_features.test_procedure: Mains supply is cut mid-travel; the car must land and release passengers unaided.

safety_features.name: Overspeed governor & safety gear
safety_features.headline: If the car ever runs fast, steel jaws close on the rails.
safety_features.description: An overspeed governor senses descent above the trip speed and mechanically engages progressive safety gear, which grips the guide rails and brings the car to a controlled stop.
safety_features.test_procedure: The governor is tripped at rated overspeed with the car loaded; the safety gear must set and hold on the rails.

safety_features.name: Firefighter recall
safety_features.headline: In an alarm the lift stops being a lift and becomes an exit route.
safety_features.description: On a fire signal the car cancels all calls, returns to the designated evacuation landing, parks with doors open and locks out normal operation until reset.
safety_features.test_procedure: The fire input is asserted; the car must recall and park without accepting car calls.

safety_features.name: Structural & seismic restraint
safety_features.headline: Rails, brackets and counterweights are tied to the structure.
safety_features.description: Guide rails, brackets and counterweight frames are designed and fixed for the seismic zone of the site, with retaining plates that keep the counterweight in its guides.
safety_features.test_procedure: Bracket spacing and fixings are verified against the shaft structure and site seismic zone.

safety_features.name: Door light curtain
safety_features.headline: The doors see you before they touch you.
safety_features.description: A full-height infrared curtain across the entrance re-opens the doors on any obstruction, with no contact required.
safety_features.test_procedure: The curtain is broken at multiple heights while closing; doors must reverse each time.

safety_features.name: Alarm & two-way intercom
safety_features.headline: Someone answers, day or night.
safety_features.description: The alarm button connects to a battery-backed intercom that reaches Zion's 24/7 service desk, independent of the building's power.
safety_features.test_procedure: The alarm is pressed with mains isolated; a voice link must be established.
